availability.missing_matrix_policy: Higher powers cannot supply the final matrix. Public full-capture matrices can supply it, with an explicit checked I/O envelope.

ordering: SHA-256 of complete canonical provenance key, then unit identifier
logical_identity: By default the closed public collection's relative input names; an optional hash-checked acquisition logical-name map preserves earlier selection identities without asserting a new historical execution.
original_implementation: Execute the extra SVD-coordinate gate from the recorded threshold and the original SymPy witness on explicit exact s. Preserve its failures independently.
completion: Registered projector/own-input correspondence gates and exact quadratic-ring six-state certificate. No changed threshold, prediction, budget or comparator.
lexicographic_witness: First i < j, ascending lexicographic order, equal anonymous initial records, unequal exact densities; first separating map/atom in registered order.
maximal_gap_witness: Maximize the absolute raw-label-zero point trace gap over i < j sharing all three labels; ties lexicographic. Check 3/20, without assuming it on new data.
atom_classification: Every active raw/package/joint atom: exact effect, exact Gram determinant, positive or singular; check no negative determinants. Empty labels excluded.
performance_fields: Not decoded. Population inference and descriptive attachments are downstream.
proof_binding: No scratch proof notes required. These are constructor certificates, not a new Lean endpoint audit. Lean input rendering/audit is downstream P3c.
